items.name: x-dialog-radix
items.title: x-dialog (Radix)
items.description: Promise-based, fully typed dialogs with window chrome — drag, maximize, stacking and close guards. `await open(dialog, payload)` returns a typed result. Built on Radix Dialog.
items.docs: Mount <DialogProvider> once near the root, declare dialogs with defineDialog(), then `const result = await open(dialog, payload)` from useDialogs(). Docs: https://github.com/AbdenourTadjer33/x-dialog#readme
